messages:
Maya: Quick heads up — AcmeHW marketplace listing needs security/compliance artifacts before we can go live. They’re asking for SOC reports, recent pen test, completed security questionnaire, and an attestation letter. Deadline they gave: next Wed EOD. Can security/legal confirm what we need from the partner vs what our platform covers?

Rafael: We have Redwood's SOC2 Type II (covers our control plane). Marketplace wants vendor-level evidence for the partner offering (AcmeHW) — so they expect either: vendor SOC2, ISO27001 cert, or a signed security attestation + pen test report. Also they require a completed security questionnaire (they accept CAIQ or our lightweight VSA).

AJ: Important: before AcmeHW shares pen-test PDFs we need an NDA or a secure upload link (sensitive findings). Request a redacted exec summary publicly and a full redacted report under NDA. For the attestation letter, we need it signed by an officer and dated within 12 months.

Sam: From marketplace ops: the listing checklist (internal) explicitly lists: 1) SOC2 or ISO27001 2) External pen test (within 12 months) 3) Security questionnaire 4) Incident response contact + email 5) Data processing addendum if they process Redwood customer data. We can’t publish without at least the attestation + redacted pen test.

Maya: OK — action items for AcmeHW to provide: - SOC2/ISO cert OR signed attestation - Redacted pen test exec summary + option for full report under NDA - Completed CAIQ (or our VSA) - Patch/firmware update policy doc - Contact for IR + POC for compliance team. Anyone want to add docs/examples we can send them?

Rafael: Add pen test scope expectations: external network + firmware + remote management interfaces. We should ask for methodology, CVE mapping, dates, and remediation status (ticket IDs or PR links if available). Prefer vendor pen-test company name + statement of independence. If they refuse full report, letter from pen-test firm confirming scope + date is acceptable for marketplace gating.

AJ: Template we use for redaction guidance: exec summary + vulnerability table (severity, CVSS, status). Redact IP/data samples. Provide signed attestation wording: "We confirm no critical open vulnerabilities as of <date> and remediation plan in place". I can draft the attestation template.

Sam: Marketplace also needs a short security blurb for the listing page — 1–2 sentences. Marketing will coordinate wording but only after artifacts are cleared.

Jen: Marketing note: joint announcement will need a security sign-off stamp. Please flag any items that will block the announcement timeline (we’re targeting the week after next).

Maya: I'll assemble an email pack we can send to AcmeHW with required artifacts + NDA link. Draft below, pls edit: 

```
Hi @AcmeHW-security,
Thanks for partnering with Redwood. To complete your marketplace listing we need:
- SOC2 Type II or ISO27001 cert (pdf) OR signed security attestation
- External pen test executive summary (redacted) and willingness to share full report under NDA
- Completed CAIQ or Redwood VSA (attached)
- Firmware/patch policy & incident response contact
Please upload to the secure share here: https://redwood.internal/secure-upload (or reply to this thread with questions). Target: artifacts by <date>.
Thanks,
Maya (Partnerships)
```

Rafael: Looks good. Add: please include pen-test vendor name, date performed, and whether any findings are public CVEs.

AJ: Also include a short NDA link and note about redaction guidance. I’ll attach the attestation template.

deploy-bot: Reminder: compliance-checklist doc updated: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/security-checklist (version 3.1) — includes sample attestation & VSA.

Sam: If they can hit the next-Wed deadline, we can keep our launch window. If not, we’ll need to delay the listing and announcement. Can we set follow-ups?

Maya: I'll send the pack today and schedule a sync with AcmeHW for Thursday. Rafael/AJ — can you review the pack by EOD so I can iterate?

Rafael: Yep, I’ll review and add pen-test scope verbiage.

AJ: I’ll send the attestation template and NDA link within 2 hours.

Jen: Thx — I’ll hold the announcement copy until sign-off. Please ping me once artifacts are uploaded. :+1:

Maya: Great — thanks everyone. Will post updates in this thread after I hear from AcmeHW.
